entries.rationale: Bind verified documentation patch releases without installing consumers; distinguish release targets, installed state and separately authorized runtime sync. / Gepruefte Dokumentations-Patches binden, ohne Verbraucherinstallation; Sollstand, Installation und getrennte Runtime-Verteilung unterscheiden.
readerPaths: README → central release report → release notes, PRs and source lock
entries.navigationImpact: README language partners link the central release record; existing navigation and historical delivery records are retained.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second; paired README language files.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: All 14 published archives verified against tagged Git blobs and installed/listed/inspected/resolved in temporary projects on macOS. Configured native CI recorded per release; central profile gates documented in the delivery PR.
entries.risk: Release targets differ intentionally from existing installed/runtime copies until separately authorized rollout/sync; no product or regulatory approval is inferred.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Preset, source hash, profile, installation or runtime-distribution contract changes.
